name: Downtown Sushi
notes: Real not-found. Own domain (thedtsushi.com) returns a generic 404/'page does not exist' shell on every path over both plain HTTP and HTTPS (checked with curl, both with and without cert verification) - it is not serving the restaurant's site any more, though it does not redirect to an unrelated business either. Yelp's business listing (title only, not the barred menu tab) is stamped 'DOWNTOWN SUSHI - CLOSED - Updated August 2026'. DoorDash's own storepageFeed API (932 4th Ave confirmed matching address) reports 'unavailableReasonKeysList: [too_far_away, current_menu_closed]' and never rendered any item cards or prices despite repeated scroll/reload attempts - consistent with the store no longer trading rather than a rendering fault. Grubhub/Seamless were not separately checked once the closure signal appeared. No alternate priced source exists. Per FINDINGS, a dead domain plus no alternate priced source is permanent, not a temporary block.

name: Okan Diner
blocked: Own domain (okanusa.com) is hijacked: curl -sIL shows a 4-hop chain of 301 redirects (via theroamingfoodiephotography.com and overthoughtdesigns.com) landing on nypizzahayward.com, which itself serves an Indonesian online-gambling site (TOKYO88) - confirmed by rendering it in-browser. Left without clicking further per policy. The two delivery-platform listings that would substitute are each gated right now: DoorDash's storepageFeed API (address 5430 Clairemont Mesa Blvd - matches) reports the store 'not active' and its GraphQL menuBook confirms a real 66-item, 10-category menu exists (Appetizers 19, Kama-Meshi 9, Ramen 4, Original Udon 6, Seiro 1, Nabeyaki 2, Hot Noodles 4, Cold Noodles 2, Hand Roll Sushi 6, Cut Roll Sushi 13) but only rendered 6 of the 19 Appetizers with prices; Grubhub shows the store 'Closed' and rendered only a 4-item 'Best Sellers' list. The two platforms disagree sharply on an overlapping dish (Grubhub 'Karaage' $16.00 vs DoorDash 'Chicken Karaage' $8.75), which is itself a sign the fragment is unreliable rather than a usable partial. SinglePlatform prices (Carbonara Udon $12.50) are roughly half Grubhub's current $20.00 for the same dish and are stale, not used. A ~10-item fragment against a confirmed 66-item menu is a thin capture and was not recorded.
notes: Re-queue rather than not-found: the domain is dead/hijacked but the restaurant itself is very likely still trading (573 recent Yelp reviews, an August-2026-dated Yelp listing, and both delivery platforms show current-looking store metadata) and a real priced menu structure is confirmed to exist behind DoorDash's API - it is just gated behind 'not active'/'closed' states at the moment of extraction.
